name: Carioca School [🎙️]
desc:
🎒 Carioca School is a school game on Roblox that brings the everyday school life of Rio de Janeiro in a fun way. Inspired by the CIEPs (Brizolões), here you experience school beyond the classroom. 

⚽ Soccer, review and competition The court is a gathering place: play ball, play with friends, and prove that your team dominates the school. 

🏫 Setting inspired by public schools in Rio de Janeiro. Architecture, climate, and details based on the real Brizolão, bringing identity and 100% immersion.
